checks.evidence: Slot default construction initializes only id. Slot::store explicitly placement-constructs Record and publishes id afterwards. place, inline insert and backshift use store; empty slots are read only through id. Trivial-copyable plus nothrow-copy construction guard payload relocation.

No-array and array representations branch on slots_, not predicted capacity_. Fresh allocation and all nonthrowing stores precede swap. Failure leaves original array or inline record, size and fields intact. Empty erasure frees storage and retains only min(previous capacity,128); release_storage clears this scalar hint.

Shared take_id remains monotonic, zero is sentinel and max IDs fail closed. Slots retain exact IDs; payload relocation changes neither public IDs nor stable backing addresses. Lease stores allocation ID, never a cross-table record pointer.

Pending Allocation and stable list Backing exist before callback unlock. After relock publication re-finds Allocation by ID. Callback failure copies Backing locally, removes owner record and original node, and invokes only deallocation/claim functions that do not use the copied self-node iterator.

Both and only backing insertion sites assign node immediately, before record insertion or publication. release callers obtain Backing from a valid nonpending record under domain mutex. std::list splice preserves node identity. No rollback local copy is passed to reclaim_standalone; duplicate/stale handles cannot recover an erased record.

Uncertain retain never calls release; aliasing provider result never deallocates old storage; poisoned callbacks retain claims and accounting without retry. Backing destructor does not implicitly remove uncertain claim. Existing conservative paths remain.

Only condition variable wait is drain under the same mutex after OPEN rejection. State is one-way OPEN to CLOSING to CLOSED. All helper calls occur with mutex held; closing and poison publication still notify. An OPEN operation cannot race a registered drain waiter, and a later waiter observes predicate/state under lock.

Arena lower-bound request condition is unchanged. New metadata growth completes before cursor/accounting commit. Pending block publication invalidates Arena search; reset remains quiet-only and invalidates search.

new_test_contracts: Owner and lease batch64 zero-live-array transition; predicted next batch uses one successful allocation; inline record still allocates zero arrays.
Prediction-triggered OOM preserves existing full record, size and live-array count; failed ID remains absent.
Explicit release_storage restores four-slot first growth; historical batch200 cannot request more than128 predicted slots for next two records.
material_costs: Backing gains one private list iterator; actual platform sizeof and allocation counts must be reported from measurement.
A historical larger batch can increase the next second-record request to128 slots despite no retained empty heap.
Fresh one-shot first growth sequence remains; scalar prediction helps only later live-set phases.
The notification optimization removes notify calls while OPEN; whether these calls reach the OS is runtime implementation dependent.
